packet.title: Identity constraints (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements xs:unique, xs:key and xs:keyref: selector and field XPath subsets checked on the AST and evaluated over the recorded subtree, with key sequences compared by typed value equality.

body.p: After . Owns src/schema_identity.c, tests/schema_identity_test.c. xs:unique, xs:key, xs:keyref and XSD 1.1's ref (Part 1, 3.11): the selector and field XPath subsets checked on the XPath front end's AST (c-selector-xpath, c-fields-xpath; xpathDefaultNamespace), evaluated by the evaluator over the subtree the 5.7 recorder keeps for the declaring element; key sequences compared by typed value equality (Part 1, 3.11.4, with XSD 1.1's identity of values), node tables carried up to ancestors for keyref (cvc-identity-constraint). Done when MS-IdentityConstraint, Sun IdConstrDefs and IBM identityConstraint and xpathDefaultNSonKeyKeyRefUnique ≥ 80%. Done 2026-10-18 (): subsets on the AST, compilation with xpath.h, unique, key and keyref on the recorded subtree with node tables from descendants; the four groups 100 % (MS 1,058, Sun 48, IBM 18 and 26).
